target_customer: Food distributors (seafood, specialty and packaged food) that run orders through legacy ERPs
problem: Order entry from email, phone, WhatsApp and fax is manual and consumes sales and customer service capacity. Ozai reads incoming messages and enters orders into the existing ERP.
business_model: B2B SaaS agents sold to distributors, expanding by department
product_category: Agentic AI for food supply chain operations

founders.name: Joseph Jacob
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch: multigenerational seafood family, worked on a shrimp processor floor in India and managed large seafood imports. YC page: bought over 400M lbs of shrimp.

founders.name: Chandru Shanmugasundaram
founders.background_notes: Built systems for legal tech, dev tools, banking and restaurant apps; built an ERP for his father's factory as a teenager per YC page.

competitors.name: Choco
competitors.what: OrderAgent AI order processing for food suppliers into ERPs

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-channel message parsing, per-customer learning and ERP integrations are standard LLM application engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Deep ERP integration and learned customer shorthand create stickiness, but Choco and Pepper offer similar order agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pepper reportedly raised a 50M Series C in April 2026 and Choco sells OrderAgent, so well funded rivals compete; no acquisition of burnt found.

market_need_then: Legacy ERPs are entrenched and order desks are manual; the company reports over 10M USD of monthly orders processed and six figure revenue after a January 2025 launch (company claims).

branding.domain_note: Uses getburnt.ai, a prefix and AI suffix rather than burnt.com.

identity.logo: Not read; company site fetch was blocked
identity.mascot_or_character: Agent named Ozai; no source explains the name

branding.brand_signature: Ozai, the named order management agent
branding.community_and_virality: Press coverage largely tied to the investor Penny Jar Capital (Steph Curry's firm) in TechCrunch and trade outlets.

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable real-word name and a named agent, with notable press through the celebrity-backed investor; negative connotation of burnt for a food business is a risk.

outcome_analysis: Burnt raised a 3.8M USD seed in September 2025 within months of YC Summer 2025, led by Penny Jar Capital, on founder domain insight in food distribution and a January 2025 launch with claimed traction. Competition from Choco and Pepper is intense, but no negative event is found and the company is Active.
notes: Round confirmed by TechCrunch and FoodNavigator USA plus multiple wire reprints. Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check, so site content was not read. The Choco dated source is a secondary citation of a March 2025 press release. Founder education not found. Name origin of Ozai is not sourced (a character of that name exists in a popular animated series but no source links it). Competition entry reflects one dated source only.
